target.title: ci: restore Apple simulator coverage
target.body:
## Summary

- Restore CI builds for the iOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS simulator targets advertised by Commander.
- Keep all simulator legs running when one fails so the matrix reports complete platform evidence.
- Refresh the multiplatform tracking document to match the real workflow, runner, and Swift 6.3.3 toolchain.

## Root cause

Commit `ce13224` reduced the Apple matrix to macOS while later documentation continued to promise simulator coverage. The package declarations and public support story still include all four simulator families, so restoring the CI owner boundary is preferable to silently downgrading that contract.

## Validation

- `swift package update --dry-run` (0 dependencies would change)
- Fresh `swift build --build-tests`
- Fresh `swift test` (16 tests passed)
- Local `xcodebuild` generic simulator builds: iOS, watchOS, and visionOS passed
- Local tvOS proof blocked only by the tvOS runtime not being installed; this PR's hosted matrix is the authoritative tvOS proof
- DocC archive generated with Commander documentation
- Fresh artifact scan: no `Commander*.bundle`
- `actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml`
- Ruby YAML parse
- Autoreview: clean; no accepted/actionable findings

## Dependency and security audit

- SwiftPM: DocC plugin 1.5.0 and SymbolKit 1.0.0 are resolver-current
- CI: `actions/checkout` 7.0.0 and `SwiftyLab/setup-swift` 1.14.0 match current stable tags and immutable pins
- Toolchain: Swift 6.3.3 matches the current stable Swift release
- Dependabot and secret-scanning open alerts: 0
- Public model identifier gate: PASS; no model-bearing surfaces

Risk: low. CI and documentation only; no Commander runtime source changes. The hosted matrix must pass all four simulator builds before merge.
